description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT (Ironstorm Spearhead, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the seven WP-M3a detachments, the Ork player 0 CP. A REAL click on End Command Phase opens command_phase_main; a REAL click on the Gladiator Lancer's Use button spends 1 CP; until the start of Player 1's next Command phase the Lancer ignores the harmful modifiers to its M, BS, hit rolls and wound rolls (the engine hooks drop -1 to hit / -1 to wound / BS worsening).
